description: Create a price list: a percent off the catalogue (percentOff, -1000 to 99.99 with 2 decimals, default 0; negative = a markup) plus fixed prices per product or variant added with set_price_list_entry / set_price_list_entries. A fixed price overrides the percent for its product or variant; every other product gets the catalogue price minus percentOff. Then assign it to a company (set_company_price_list) or to a customer without a company (set_customer_price_list) - each buyer has one list: a company's members pay the company's list. startsAt / endsAt limit when it prices; outside that window its buyers pay catalogue prices. channels publishes it to sales channels by key: storefronts sending that channel are priced from it (a buyer's own or company list still wins for every product it prices), and anyone can read the prices of a list published to a PUBLIC channel.

channels.description: Keys of the sales channels to publish the list to (from list_sales_channels), at most 20. A channel takes one undated base list plus dated lists whose windows do not overlap; a clash is refused (CHANNEL_BASE_TAKEN or CHANNEL_WINDOW_OVERLAP). Anyone can read the prices of a list published to a PUBLIC channel.

endsAt.description: ISO date-time the list stops pricing buyers at, later than startsAt. null clears it (no end); leave it out to keep it. Outside its window a list prices nobody: its buyers pay catalogue prices.

name.description: The list's name, unique in the workspace (e.g. 'Gold')

percentOff.description: Percent taken off the catalogue price (and every volume break) of each product the list holds no fixed price for: -1000 to 99.99, at most two decimals (12.5 = 12.5% off). A negative value is a markup above the catalogue (-10 = 10% more). 0 = the list prices only through its fixed prices.

startsAt.description: ISO date-time the list starts pricing buyers from. null clears it (priced from now on); leave it out to keep it.

name: create_price_list
title: Create price list
